heading: Support my work

intro.end: , running 24/7 on a home server that I also maintain myself. If any of them have been useful to you, consider supporting my work. Even a small donation helps keep the servers online and motivates me to keep going. Thank you!

paypal: A quick one-time donation. No account is required when paying by card. The simplest option.
patreon: Monthly support. A good choice if you regularly use my tools and want to support them on an ongoing basis.
kofi: Buy me a coffee. Casual one-time or recurring support. No account required.
github: Sponsor me directly on GitHub. Monthly tiers are available. Your support appears on my GitHub profile.

steam.title: CS2 skins and Steam items
steam.description: Have items in your Steam inventory you'd like to donate? CS2 skins and other Steam items are welcome and greatly appreciated.

why.title: Why support my work?
why.description: My servers process thousands of your requests every day. Your support directly helps keep these services available 24/7 for everyone. Why don't I host my services for free on Oracle? Well, I don't want to depend on outside companies or hand over all my personal details just to get a free VPS. I have self-respect.

note: All my open source projects are entirely non-profit. I develop them after hours, in my free time, without any pay. If you decide to support their upkeep, every donation, however small, means a lot to me and motivates me to keep working. Thank you from the bottom of my heart! ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
